# ClassPanel.online — Comprehensive System & Architectural Context for LLMs

> ClassPanel (https://classpanel.online/) is a free, privacy-first web platform offering 23 interactive productivity tools, educational countdown timers, group generators, and decision utilities.

## Core Architectural Guarantees
- **Privacy & Compliance**: 100% FERPA and COPPA compliant. No cookies for student tracking, no account creation, no server-side roster storage. All student names, lists, and timer settings reside solely in HTML5 LocalStorage inside the user's browser.
- **Offline Reliability (PWA)**: Runs anywhere without internet. The Service Worker caches HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Web Audio synthesizers for uninterrupted classroom operation even during school Wi-Fi blackouts.
- **Display Optimization**: High-contrast, clean typography legible across large smartboards, ViewSonic panels, Promethean boards, and lecture hall projectors.
- **Accessibility & Shortcuts**: Full keyboard navigation (`Space` to Start/Pause, `R` to Reset, `F` for Fullscreen Projector mode).

---

## Complete Tools Directory & Technical Specifications

### 1. Classroom & Study Timer
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/classroom-timer/
- **Description**: Giant digital countdown timer and Pomodoro focus timer with visual color progress rings (green -> amber -> red) and optional calming background soundscapes (Zen waves, rain, alpha frequency).
- **Primary Use**: Classroom transition pacing, timed reading, Pomodoro 25/5 focus blocks, science lab countdowns.

### 2. Wheel of Names & Random Picker
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/random-name-picker/
- **Description**: Canvas-rendered customizable spinning wheel. Supports pasting student rosters, confetti celebration on selection, sound effects, and an optional "Eliminate Selected" toggle to avoid repeated picks.
- **Primary Use**: Cold calling, student presentations, raffle drawings, chore delegation.

### 3. Random Group Generator & Team Maker
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/group-generator/
- **Description**: Algorithmic team formation tool. Allows teachers to paste a roster and either specify "Number of Groups" or "Members per Group". Supports drag-and-drop manual adjustments.
- **Primary Use**: Science lab groups, debate teams, classroom pods, cooperative learning.

### 4. Official Exam & Test Timer
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/exam-timer/
- **Description**: Formal examination dashboard displaying synchronized wall clock time, exam countdown, reading time phase, silent warning checkpoints (15m, 5m, 1m), and whiteboard test instructions.
- **Primary Use**: SAT, ACT, AP, GCSE, IB, university midterms, and mock tests.

### 5. Meditation & Sensory Calming Timer
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/sensory-timer/
- **Description**: Guided visual breathwork pacer featuring Box Breathing (4-4-4-4), 4-7-8 Relaxing Breath, and Coherence Breathing, accompanied by gentle 528Hz Solfeggio acoustic chimes.
- **Primary Use**: Classroom emotional regulation, post-recess transitions, ADHD focus resets, mindfulness.

### 6. Online Clocks & Time Display
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/clocks/
- **Description**: Fullscreen synchronized analog clock and 12/24-hour digital clock. Includes interactive time-telling quiz modules for elementary education.
- **Primary Use**: Teaching analog time, classroom wall clock replacement, study room display.

### 7. Random Number Generator (RNG)
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/random-number-generator/
- **Description**: Cryptographically secure random integer and decimal generator with customizable minimum/maximum ranges, batch generation, and duplicate exclusion.
- **Primary Use**: Math probability lessons, contest drawings, secret number games.

### 8. Chance Games & Mystery Hub
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/chance-games/
- **Description**: Interactive gamified selection tools including 3D Mystery Treasure Chests, Lucky Spin Wheels, and a Cosmic Magic 8-Ball oracle.
- **Primary Use**: Classroom reward days, icebreakers, gamified quiz questions.

### 9. Multi-Team Tally Counter
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/tally-counter/
- **Description**: Multi-column clicker counter with custom team labels, color coding, step increments (+1, +5, -1), and total summation.
- **Primary Use**: Classroom behavior points, field day games, attendance counts, science experiments.

### 10. Presentation & Speech Timer (Toastmasters-Style)
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/presentation-timer/
- **Description**: Traffic light speech pacer automatically shifting from Green (minimum time met) to Amber (warning) and Red (maximum time elapsed).
- **Primary Use**: Student speeches, debate clubs, Toastmasters meetings, conference presentations.

### 11. Animated Race Timers & F1 Start Lights
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/race-timers/
- **Description**: 5-red-light Formula 1 reaction timer reflex test and multi-lane animated sprite sprint races (Space Race, Ocean Race, Jungle Race, Dragon Race).
- **Primary Use**: Reflex training, science physics demonstrations, high-energy brain breaks.

### 12. Countdown to Any Date & Event
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/holiday-timers/
- **Description**: Precision day, hour, minute, second countdown ticker for future dates, holidays, exams, end of school year, or OBS streaming overlays.
- **Primary Use**: School semester countdown, holiday celebrations, event tickers.

### 13. Rock Paper Scissors Online
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/rock-paper-scissors/
- **Description**: Fast decision game against adaptive computer AI with Best-of-3/5/7 match modes and streak tracking.
- **Primary Use**: Quick tiebreakers, fair dispute resolution, game theory lessons.

### 14. 3D Flip a Coin Simulator
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/coin-flip/
- **Description**: Physics-based 3D metallic coin toss with realistic acoustic clinks and simultaneous multi-coin tossing (1 to 10 coins) with statistical heads/tails breakdown.
- **Primary Use**: Probability demonstrations, coin tosses, fair binary decisions.

### 15. Polyhedral 3D Dice Roller
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/dice-roller/
- **Description**: Full RPG polyhedral set (d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, d100) with physics roll animations, instant summation, and modifier arithmetic.
- **Primary Use**: Tabletop games, D&D, probability lessons, math games.

### 16. Color Picker & Palette Studio
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/color-picker/
- **Description**: Visual HEX, RGB, HSL, and CMYK color converter with WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio verification and curated harmonious palettes.
- **Primary Use**: Art classrooms, web design courses, accessible document creation.

### 17. Millisecond Online Stopwatch
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/stopwatch/
- **Description**: High-precision stopwatch measuring tenths and hundredths of seconds with split lap recording and instant fastest/slowest lap comparison.
- **Primary Use**: Physical education, science lab time trials, track and field sprints.

### 18. Online Metronome
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/metronome/
- **Description**: Studio-grade visual and acoustic tempo metronome (20-300 BPM) with time signature accents, subdivision clicks, and Tap Tempo.
- **Primary Use**: Band and choir practice, music theory, rhythmic pacing.

### 19. Chess Clock & Game Timer
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/chess-timer/
- **Description**: Dual-sided digital chess clock supporting standard tournament formats (Blitz, Rapid, Bullet, Classical) and Fischer delay/increment time controls.
- **Primary Use**: Chess clubs, board game tournaments, Scrabble matches.

### 20. Talking Clock & Interval Announcer
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/talking-clock/
- **Description**: Natural voice speech-synthesized audio announcer speaking current time, remaining time intervals, and classroom cues.
- **Primary Use**: Visually impaired accessibility, audio-first study spaces, hands-free work.

### 22. Custom Timer Maker
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/custom-timer/
- **Description**: Personalized countdown timer builder with custom title labels, custom sound alarms, themes, and shareable encoded URLs.
- **Primary Use**: Custom teacher routines, workout pacing, specific study tasks.

### 23. Precision Split Lap Timer
- **URL**: https://classpanel.online/tools/split-timer/
- **Description**: Multi-participant split timer recording individual split benchmarks for fitness assessment and race heats.
- **Primary Use**: Athletics coaching, swim meets, circuit training.
